name: DXN Holdings Bhd.
summary: DXN Holdings Bhd. provides health food supplements in Malaysia, rest of Asia, Latin America, the Middle East, Europe, Africa, Oceania, and North America. It operates through Health and Wellness Consumer Products; Investment Holding; and Other Non-Reportable segments. The company offers fortified food and beverages, health and dietary supplements, personal care products, and skin care and cosmetics, as well as management services. It also engages in the formulation of medicines; commercial lab testing; research, development, and experimental work on biotechnology, biochemicals, and bio-agricultural products; and open-source technology solutions.
